about.label: SIMULATION-based costs; funding model for one feeder (1 battery, 1090 homes). Rs per year unless stated.

local_operator_inr_per_month.note: a part-time trained local operator (for example from a women's self-help group): daily checks, first-line faults, the residents' help desk

transformer_augmentation_inr.note: MSEDCL activity rates (Nov 2024), item 1305, augmentation of an existing distribution transformer centre from 315 to 630 kVA, DPR rate (Rs lakh)

discom_cost_of_capital.note: deferring that augmentation by a year is worth its capital cost x this rate

tn_free_power_subsidy_inr_per_year.note: Tamil Nadu, May 2026: free domestic units raised from 100 to 200 per bill; adds about Rs 1,730 crore a year to the subsidy (DT Next, 10 May 2026; TNERC approved Rs 1,545 crore for 326 days of 2026-27, Mercom, 28 May 2026)

tn_free_power_extra_consumers.note: consumers who gain from the change (DT Next)

vgf_inr_per_mwh.note: Ministry of Power viability gap funding, second tranche (June 2025): Rs 1.8 million per MWh of battery storage, 30 GWh (Mercom, 10 June 2025). For grid-scale tenders; community batteries would need to be aggregated into a state tender
